mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees and fair at Harriet Park.
The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on December 7 to discuss development projects like the Sub-Zero site plan, and officials are currently posting general election notices for the public.

Today, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market or live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company or the John Denver tribute show at the High School.
In our weekly police report, we noted an incident on October 23 where two juveniles were cited for operating prohibited eMotos after previously receiving warnings.
Today's Flavor of the Day is the delicious Caramel Cashew. Please note that Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
